messages:
nina: Customer reported duplicate token charges after a streaming retry during a model route swap. Short logs attached.
omar: Likely the same pattern: route swap clears ephemeral session headers so retry looks new.
lee: Logs: `2026-05-02T11:23:10Z stream EOF; wrote toolcall id=tc-51; 2026-05-02T11:23:11Z router swap->clear-ephemeral; 2026-05-02T11:23:11Z client replay->toolcall id=tc-51-R`
nina: Two mitigations discussed: require client idempotency token OR server-side fingerprint dedupe for provisional billing. Can't force clients immediately.
omar: Server fingerprint proposal: sha256(normalized_payload + tool_name + customer_id) with TTL 1s; only suppress if prior event is PROVISIONAL and reconnect_delta < 500ms. Record suppression record instead of deleting events.
lee: Telemetry fields: dedupe.applied, dedupe.fingerprint, dedupe.suppressed, dedupe.trace_link. Backfill fingerprint for last 7 days to check collision rate.
console-team: UX: show "Suppressed (heuristic)" badge, hover text explaining heuristic, and link to raw events + "Request audit" button. Add filter for suppressed charges.
billing-bot: Feature-flag created: server_retry_dedupe; per-customer opt-out tag `no_server_dedupe`. Canary planned.
nina: I'll open ticket RW-12001 to track server patch + telemetry + UI. Owners: omar -> server (10d), lee -> telemetry (4d), console-team -> UI next sprint.
lee: Note: suppression affects billing events only, not the actual execution; document for customers.
billing-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-05-09 09:00 UTC (5% traffic).
